versions.name: Rodney Scout Reservation
versions.address: 400 Rodney Scout Road North East, Maryland 21901

features.note: Bull Mountain Studios covers handicraft plus moviemaking, photography, music, and graphic arts.
Off-site high-adventure sailing on the Chesapeake for Scouts fourteen and older.
Camp-provided mountain bikes in the health and fitness area.
The N.E.S.T. Center has computer and science laboratories.
The Advanced Camper Experience for Scouts fourteen and older.
A pool with three deep ends.
A dedicated sailing base on the Chesapeake, with a regatta race.
Over a mile of Chesapeake Bay shoreline; the only Scout camp on the bay.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/081-RSRSummer); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
